info.name: Mototrack apis
info.description: Complete API Collection for GPS-WOX GPS Tracking Platform

urlencoded.value: POLYGON((lng1 lat1, lng2 lat2, lng3 lat3, lng4 lat4, lng1 lat1))

query.description: status=Moving, status=Engine Off, status=Engine On, status=Idling, status=Offline
Matches vehicle name or IMEI. Partial text works, and it's not case-sensitive.
